universe.negative_universe_scope: The same 37 PDF-grounded negative controls; diagnostic bounds only

limitations_en: Every source atom and generated class has a structurally enumerated judgment, but actual full semantic entailment is not human-certified.
Conservative E1/E0 dispositions and undercontextualized generated extraction may materially change both FP and FN counts.
The TP proof map shows actual file/line and full table-row context; automatic predicate status cannot independently certify scope, exception and version equivalence.
The original 1024-atom source denominator is deliberately reused unchanged; source split/merge errors have not been demonstrated conclusively and may remain.
Generated raw duplication is conservative: candidates below very high full-predicate similarity remain separated.
The 37 negative controls are bounded and TN does not enumerate all absent design capabilities.
